title: SolidWorks
description: Drive a local SolidWorks desktop through MCP: 71 CAD tools for parts, assemblies, drawings, DFM checks, and FEA. Read-only by default - only 19 read-only tools are published until you raise the plugin mode.

entry.summary: SolidWorks tools run against your own desktop session. Under the default read-only mode only 19 read-only inspection tools are published; switch the plugin mode to "standard" for modelling or "full" for save/export/close. High-risk calls require an interactive approval prompt in the DSH host UI - the plugin cannot approve itself (solidworks_confirm is diagnostic-only and always refused).
entry.setup: Requires Windows x64, a licensed SolidWorks desktop (real-machine validated only on SolidWorks 2026 SP4.1; 2020-2025 are claimed but untested), and a Python 3.10+ x64 interpreter with the mcp and pywin32 packages. Run `node bin/dsh-solidworks.js doctor --json` to check the interpreter and SolidWorks; add `--profile` to also check how the plugin is configured in your installed DSH profile.
